DREAD.IRONCLAD.description: Ironclad's Dominion: at the start of each combat, all enemies gain 1 Demon Form.
DREAD.SILENT.description: Kekuasaan Si Pendiam: pada awal setiap pertarungan, kamu kehilangan 1 Kekuatan dan memperoleh 1 Lemah (di pertarungan Elite: 2 Kekuatan dan 2 Lemah).
DREAD.DEFECT.description: Defect's Dominion: at the end of your turn, take 3 damage for each enemy.
DREAD.NECROBINDER.description: Necrobinder's Dominion: at the start of your turn, a random card in your hand costs 1 more this turn.
DREAD.REGENT.description: Regent's Dominion: whenever an enemy attacks you, you lose 1 Strength this turn.
DREAD.WATCHER.description: Kekuasaan Pengamat: pada awal setiap pertarungan, semua pemain memperoleh 3 [gold]Kesalehan[/gold] (saat giliran pemegangnya dimulai, Pengamat memperoleh 3 [gold]Mantra[/gold]).
DREAD.FOOL.description: Kekuasaan Si Bodoh: pada awal setiap pertarungan, 2 [gold]Kesedihan[/gold] ditambahkan ke tumpukan undianmu.
